baseline.limitation: API/fixture-export absence proves missing provenance feature, not14 engine semantic bugs.

conformance.note: Fresh concrete Function.prototype.bind and class-TDZ variants. No ownership or provenance API coverage.

contract.query: getNativeSourceModule reads only private source label, without executing capture factory/getters or Proxy traps.
contract.producer: Production builder supplies normalized maintained engine module names; transform injects private registerEngineClosure. Registrar is not exported by engine API and is not exposed by the tested parent manifest.
contract.revocation: Every public registerNativeClosure replacement clears provenance, including previously labeled engine closures.
contract.boundary: Private carrier belongs to a runtime instance. Source labels from a separately compiled bundle are not accepted by this engine. Build tools can issue labels; they remain trusted, not a sandbox.
contract.negativeControls: Origin remains present despite unowned mutable own-property state and unresolved class-state marker. Registration/source origin are not ownership or effect permission.

react.scope: Actual React bound dispatch is a guest object without a native label; its original Call implementation has FunctionPrototype module provenance. Mount/increment/unmount snapshots match an independent native run, with stable dispatch identity. Not shared-prefix isolation.

retainedFindings: Initial42 focused run:1failure/41pass. Test incorrectly looked for [[ClassState]] among bindings; original manifest stores it among ambientNames. Corrected assertion, not runtime.
Review suggested private-registrar capture exposure and labeled lowered-generator coverage. Both added.

Expanded94 run:1failure/93pass. Parent factory manifest includes its existing self-binding create, not an empty list. Final assertion checks that exact self reference and no injected registrar. Failure retained.
Read-only review found no provenance forgery, registrar exposure, or capture/GC defect. It did not execute gates.
Plugin sourceModule option is read once; normalized module labels preserve relocated build bytes.
limitations: Source labels are not signatures, storage schemas, complete capture manifests, readonly validation, effect contracts or execution authority.
Original class/proxy/private state, ambient capabilities, mutable referents and function own properties still need policies.
Control runtime remains excluded from source transformation. Unregistered/unsupported forms and public replacements can lack labels even when produced by engine code.
Default standalone transforms use public registration. Opt-in compiler labels are trusted build input; separate runtimes have separate private brands.
No automatic owner or pre-capture admission policy added. Future confinement still must reject unsupported calls/allocations/effects.
No general React isolation, automatic reports, guarded transitions, repeated-state families, or integrated demo; existing reports remain unverified.
